column2: Dawn light. A clay breakfast table. Two hands in a sage-green cardigan sleeve with a jade bangle hold a cream clay coffee cup, tired posture. A clay smartphone lies on the table, its screen glowing with a row of seven small round faces from sad (blue) to happy (pink), icons only, no text. Hun stands next to a small sugar jar on the table, looking up at the hands. Medium shot. HANDS: exactly two hands, the left and right hand of ONE person (Mẹ) sitting just off-frame at the right; both sleeves enter from the right edge, side by side, wrists and forearms continuous and natural. Five fingers each, relaxed, anatomically correct clay hands; the right hand wraps around the cup handle naturally, the left hand rests flat on the table near the phone. No extra or floating hands.
column3: f02: steam from the cup curls. f03: one hand lets go of the cup and moves toward the phone. f04: the hand hovers above the phone. f05: Hun tilts its head. f06: Hun blinks. f07: the thumb touches the phone screen edge. f08: tiny settle.

column2: Sunday evening, warm yellow lamp light. Top-down view of a round low clay family dinner table: four bowls of rice, several clay dishes, hands reaching with chopsticks: a sage cardigan sleeve with jade bangle, a navy striped sleeve with wristwatch, a small mustard-yellow sleeve. Hun stands in the middle of the table pushing a small bowl of fish sauce toward the small mustard-yellow-sleeved hand. HANDS: exactly three hands, one per person, each entering from that person's own side of the table: the sage-cardigan hand with jade bangle from the top-left edge, the navy-striped hand with wristwatch from the top-right edge, the small mustard-yellow hand from the bottom-right edge. Each hand holds chopsticks the natural way (or the small hand holds the bowl), five fingers, correct clay anatomy, forearm continuous from the sleeve. No extra or floating hands. Hun stands upright on the table (not lying down), short stubby flippers.
column3: f02: Hun pushes the bowl a little. f03: bowl moves further. f04: the small hand reaches toward the bowl. f05: the small hand takes the bowl. f06: chopsticks of the other hands move to new dishes. f07: Hun stands upright, proud. f08: tiny settle.

column2: Close-up on the clay smartphone on the breakfast table: an index finger (sage-green cardigan sleeve) slides across the row of seven faces and stops on the fifth face (small smile), which glows softly. Hun at the edge of the frame gives a small happy nod. Steam from the cup in the background. HANDS: exactly one hand of Me, entering from the right edge in the sage cardigan sleeve with the jade bangle. She points with her INDEX finger (the finger right next to the thumb); the middle, ring and little fingers are curled loosely into the palm, the thumb rests relaxed along the side. Five fingers total, natural proportions, no extra or missing fingers. The pointing gesture must read as a gentle tap, never as a rude gesture.
column3: f02: finger at the third face. f03: finger at the fourth face. f04: finger on the fifth face. f05: the fifth face glows. f06: Hun nods down. f07: Hun nods back up, small smile. f08: tiny settle.

column2: POST-CREDIT SCENE. Night, after the film. The same cosy clay living room as chapter 2 (terracotta clay sofa, rug with a small flower pattern, wooden shelf with clay jars), the lights off: cool blue moonlight from the window and soft shadows. Hun is ALONE in the middle of the rug and thinks nobody is watching: it does a silly happy little dance, one short flipper up, one foot lifted, eyes closed, big blissful smile. At the right edge of the frame a clay floor lamp (switched off) with a small round switch on its pole. Wide shot, camera locked off for the whole scene. HANDS: only one hand appears later, Ba's: a navy striped shirt sleeve with a brown leather wristwatch, entering from the right edge; never a face or body.
column3: f02: Hun hops, both flippers up, eyes still closed. f03: Hun turns a quarter on one foot, blissful. f04: Hun wiggles its tail, one foot up, flippers out. f05: Ba's hand (navy striped sleeve, wristwatch) enters from the right edge and touches the lamp switch, Hun still dancing, unaware. f06: the lamp is ON, warm yellow light fills the room, Hun freezes mid pose, eyes wide open, one flipper still up. f07: Hun stays frozen in the pose and only its eyes slide toward the hand. f08: Hun slowly lowers the flipper, cheeks very pink, small embarrassed smile, the hand still on the switch.
